goal: Identify the conflicting event and exact overlap, then decide whether to continue reviewing without approving.
method: Blind comparison of neutral current-source mobile screenshots. Candidate X includes the backend-authored exact overlap; candidate Y shows the event and occupied interval only.

mapping_after_judgment.X: Shows 客户评审, occupied interval 15:30–16:30, and exact overlap 15:30–16:00.
mapping_after_judgment.Y: Shows 客户评审 and occupied interval 15:30–16:30, without the explicit overlap interval.

judge.reason: X states the exact 15:30–16:00 conflict, reducing interval-comparison effort; Y frames more surrounding proposal context in the screenshot.

limitations: The screenshots show the details disclosure collapsed.
Static screenshots do not establish live scrolling, keyboard interaction, execution, or assistive-technology behavior.
The pair is one independent judgment, not a participant study.
